text: The doctor was very skilled and explained patiently. I could tell he was trying. However, the assistant was fierce and didn't speak very well. He used a bad accent, such as telling me not to move my tongue or tense up, using a tone of voice as if I was displeased. The patient didn't want to move, but it hurt, and my body automatically responded. As a service worker, shouldn't I speak to my patients better? The patients were already in pain, and yet they received this kind of treatment? It felt like I was getting free dental treatment, even though I paid for it. I definitely won't be coming back here again.
